name: vix_regime_switch_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: India VIX directly governs NIFTY's intraday microstructure regime. When VIX < 14, market makers dominate with tight two-way liquidity, NIFTY oscillates ±10-20 spot points around its 20-minute Bollinger midline, and every large deviation is faded by institutional algorithms benchmarked to VWAP. When VIX > 18, directional institutional and FII flows dominate: each 5-second bar during a trend has follow-through as delta-hedging by option market makers amplifies the move. By detecting VIX regime at 5-second resolution and deploying BB-reversal logic in low-VIX vs. EMA-crossover momentum logic in elevated-VIX, we match entry logic to the microstructure actually operating — avoiding whipsaw entries in trending conditions and fade entries in ranging conditions.

indicators.name: vix_close
indicators.formula: India VIX 5-second close, joined asof to spot bars
indicators.purpose: Instantaneous VIX level determines which sub-strategy fires. No lookback needed — regime is assessed bar-by-bar.

indicators.name: vix_std_360
indicators.purpose: 30-minute VIX volatility-of-volatility filter. If VIX itself has been volatile (std > 1.5), we're near a regime boundary and signals are unreliable (original spec: 'VIX stable in current regime for > 30 min'). 360 bars = 30 min × 12 bars/min.

indicators.name: bb_upper_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute upper Bollinger Band. Matches the original 20-bar 1-minute BB exactly in calendar time. In low-VIX mean-reversion mode, a close above this band with RSI overbought is the short trigger. 240 bars = 20 min at 5s resolution.

indicators.name: bb_lower_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute lower Bollinger Band. Companion to bb_upper. A close below this band with RSI oversold in low-VIX environment signals a mean-reversion buy — NIFTY has been pushed to the 2-sigma edge of its 20-minute range.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute RSI as entry confirmation for mean-reversion. Original used RSI(14) on 1-min = 14-minute window. We compress to 36 bars (3 min) because we're targeting the fast reversion from the BB extreme, not the slow oscillator cycle. A 3-min RSI reaching <35 or >65 at a BB extreme confirms localized exhaustion on NIFTY.

indicators.name: adx_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute ADX as regime-confirmation for both sub-strategies. In mean-reversion mode: ADX < 25 confirms NIFTY is ranging. In momentum mode: ADX > 25 confirms a real trend is underway. 60 bars = 5 min, matches original 14-period 1-min bar = 14 min. Compressed to 5 min because trend/range distinction at NIFTY's 5-second scale is confirmed faster than in single-stock equity.

indicators.name: ema_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute fast EMA for momentum crossover. Original EMA_9 on 1-min = 9-minute horizon. Compressed from 9 to 3 minutes because we hold 30-90 seconds — the fast EMA must respond to moves within the hold window, not moves from an hour ago. At 5-second bars, EMA(36) tracks the last 3 minutes of price action accurately.

indicators.name: ema_120
indicators.purpose: 10-minute slow EMA as trend-direction context. Original EMA_21 on 1-min = 21-minute horizon. We use 120 bars (10 min) — not a blind scaling of 21 × 12 = 252, but a deliberate choice: 10 minutes captures the primary intraday trend direction for institutional TWAP/VWAP flow, which is the driver in elevated-VIX environments on NIFTY.

indicators.name: ema36_slope_3
indicators.purpose: 15-second EMA acceleration. Replaces original '3-bar slope confirmation'. At 5-second bars, 3 bars = 15 seconds. A positive EMA slope over 15 seconds confirms the momentum is active right now, not just that the crossover happened bars ago.

conditions: MODE A (low VIX): vix_close < vix_low_threshold (default 14.0) AND close < bb_lower_240 AND rsi_36 < rsi_oversold (default 35) AND adx_60 < adx_trend_threshold (default 25)
MODE B (elevated VIX): vix_close >= vix_high_threshold (default 18.0) AND vix_close < 25.0 AND ema_36 > ema_120 AND ema36_slope_3 > 0 AND adx_60 > adx_trend_threshold (default 25)
buy_ce.confirmation: vix_std_360 < 1.5 (regime is stable, not flip-flopping at a boundary)

conditions: MODE A (low VIX): vix_close < vix_low_threshold AND close > bb_upper_240 AND rsi_36 > rsi_overbought (default 65) AND adx_60 < adx_trend_threshold
MODE B (elevated VIX): vix_close >= vix_high_threshold AND vix_close < 25.0 AND ema_36 < ema_120 AND ema36_slope_3 < 0 AND adx_60 > adx_trend_threshold

exit.stop_rationale: Mean-rev stop 3 pts: in low-VIX ranging NIFTY, a close beyond the BB by >6 spot points (~3 option pts at delta 0.5) means the deviation is widening not reverting — thesis is broken. Momentum stop 5 pts: NIFTY in elevated-VIX should not retrace more than 10 spot points (~5 option pts) within 30 seconds on a valid trend continuation entry.
exit.target_rationale: Mean-rev target 5 pts: reversion from BB extreme to SMA midline typically covers 15-25 spot points (~7-12 option pts); capturing 5 option pts = ~50% of median move (conservative, 1:1.67 R:R). Momentum target 8 pts: first momentum leg in elevated-VIX NIFTY moves 20-30 spot points; 8 option pts captures ~40% of expected move (1:1.6 R:R).

filters.vix_filter: Core filter — VIX regime determines sub-strategy; crisis regime (VIX >= 25) = no new entries; VIX std_360 >= 1.5 = skip (regime transition in progress)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST; both modes active throughout session
filters.volume_filter: None — NIFTY index volume is structurally noisy at 5s; regime/indicator signals sufficient
filters.trend_filter: ADX < 25 enforces ranging context for mean-rev mode; ADX > 25 enforces trending context for momentum mode
filters.spread_filter: Not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — VIX boundary thresholds (14, 18) may drift as Indian market matures; thresholds are tunable via Optuna

adaptation_notes: Original traded NIFTY50 constituent equities (top 20 by liquidity), which acted as proxies for the index direction. We remove the equity-universe entirely and trade NIFTY index options directly. The regime-switching logic is preserved intact: BB+RSI in low-VIX, EMA-crossover+ADX in elevated-VIX. Three changes: (1) All lookbacks compressed/recalibrated for 5-second bars as documented in indicator purpose fields; (2) Stop/target now expressed in option premium points with regime-conditional values (3 pts / 5 pts stop, 5 pts / 8 pts target); (3) Added VIX stability filter (30-min VIX std) to prevent trading at regime transitions where both sub-strategies would misfire.
weaknesses: VIX boundary thresholds (14, 18) are tunable defaults but still have threshold risk — signals near 14 and 18 may generate frequent whipsaws if VIX oscillates around these levels intraday
ADX at 5-second frequency on an index can lag; rapid regime changes (e.g., news spike) may see ADX confirm trend only after the best entry has passed
In normal-VIX environments (14-18), neither sub-strategy fires — this dead zone represents 30-40% of intraday time when VIX is in its most common range
Mean-reversion BB signals require 240-bar (20-min) warmup before first trade, limiting utility in the opening 20 minutes

_source.original_stop: mean_rev: 0.3 * ATR14 beyond BB; momentum: 0.8 * ATR14
